posts.title: Ender Updated
posts.description: When I got a 3D printer I swore I would not be one of those people who spent all their time printing upgrades for their 3D printer. I’m not doing too badly, but printing with the Ender 3 is nonetheless a bit of a self-referential hobby. Mine has recently been failing to print cleanly and I’ve been putting off the investigation - this weekend was time to dig in and fix it.
